Hi Anna — thanks for the clear requirements and the SOW. High-level reply below; I’ll follow up with internal capacity checks and a written proposal.

Quick read: based on ~18 sustained concurrency and avg seq ~1k, Llama2-70B (4-bit), our recommendation is a conservative starting pool that balances latency SLOs and cost:
- Baseline: 3x H100-class GPUs (dedicated) configured with continuous batching and KV prefix caching — expected to cover 12–20 steady concurrency at 1k seq with p95 latency targets preserved.
- Burst: +1–2 GPUs as burst (pre-warm/burst policy) to absorb short spikes to ~25.
- Fallback: route to hosted EU pool if APAC transient capacity constrains (we can set a 2-region policy with latency threshold).

Commit options: 6-month reserved yields better pricing; 12-month gets deeper discounts. If you need to start immediately and APAC H100s are limited, we can mix in A100-80GB equivalents (small perf penalty ~10–18%).

I’ve cc’d Lauren for contract signal and will pull procurement pricing ranges. Do you have a preferred SLA (p95 latency or max tail)? Also, can you confirm expected QPS average outside the peak windows (helps with batching config).

I’ll send a detailed slide and capacity sketch after I sync with infra.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Internal — sizing proposal for VentureScale (VS-9243) — APAC pool

Aditya — thanks for the note and the sketch. Quick constraints / options from APAC capacity: 
- Availability: We have H100 capacity windows late-May but they are tight; we can commit 3xH100 starting June 1 if we shift one existing burst allocation (needs a 2-week cooldown). If customer absolutely needs guaranteed H100s without any risk we should aim for a July 1 start.
- Hybrid option: 2xH100 + 2xA100-80GB (A100s configured with optimized kernels) — expected perf hit ~12–18% on tail latency; still acceptable for many customers.
- Pricing: For a 6-month reserved pool in APAC, expect ~18% premium over comparable US pricing due to regional infra costs. 12-month lock drops that to ~10% premium.
- Operational ask: We prefer a minimum 4-week lead time for dedicated network config (VPC peering, routing, KMS).

Recommendation: Offer the customer two SKUs in the proposal: 
A) Conservative: 3xH100 + 1x burst (recommended, best latency) — earliest start June 1 but includes a 24–48h soft risk window while we shift the burst allocations.
B) Hybrid (fast): 2xH100 + 2xA100 — guaranteed capacity for June 1, slightly higher latency, cheaper than buying additional burst H100s.

I’ll flag this with cloud ops to reserve the necessary host slots once the customer signs LOI.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference

Anna — circling back with a consolidated plan and clear next steps. Thanks for the SOW — I’ve attached an internal capacity sketch as well. Below are two actionable SKUs we can offer to match your June 1 timeline.

Option A — Latency-first (recommended)
- Configuration: 3x H100-class GPUs dedicated + 1x H100 burst
- Expected steady concurrency coverage: 12–20 at ~1k seq, short spikes to 25 handled by burst
- Pricing: 6-month commitment (APAC premium) — estimated monthly pool fee: [we will provide a formal quote; expect ~18% premium vs US].
- Lead time: earliest June 1 (soft risk window 24–48h while we reassign burst capacity)

Option B — Availability-first (hybrid, fast start)
- Configuration: 2x H100 + 2x A100-80GB (optimized kernels)
- Expected perf: ~12–18% higher tail latency; predictable June 1 start
- Pricing: slightly lower than A (reflects mixed GPU mix)

Operational & contract notes:
- Network: 4-week lead time for VPC peering and KMS if you want a private deployment on day one (we can run with a hosted-network first and migrate to VPC later).
- Billing: Standard reserved pool model + per-token overage. Karthik — I asked for the draft numbers; will circulate once he confirms.
- LOI / SOW: If you can confirm SKU choice and term (6 or 12 months), we’ll issue a commercial LOI this week and trigger capacity reservation.

Next steps:
1) Anna — pick Option A or B and preferred commitment (6/12 months)
2) Procurement — if you want a preliminary commercial, I’ll loop in Karthik for a quote and Lauren for signing cadence
3) I propose a 30-min alignment call tomorrow (11:00 APAC / 22:00 Redwood PT) to lock details if that works for you
